fn CountValidMinutes(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a >= 0)
  requires (b >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if ((a <= 0) or (b <= 0)) then 0 else if ((a == 1) and (b == 1)) then 0 else ((if ((a > 1) or (b > 1)) then 1 else 0) + CountValidMinutes(if (a < b) then (a + 1) else (a - 2), if (a < b) then (b - 2) else (b + 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (CountValidMinutes(0, 0) == 0)
  example (CountValidMinutes(1, 2) == 1)
{
  if ((a <= 0) or (b <= 0)) then 0 else if ((a == 1) and (b == 1)) then 0 else ((if ((a > 1) or (b > 1)) then 1 else 0) + CountValidMinutes(if (a < b) then (a + 1) else (a - 2), if (a < b) then (b - 2) else (b + 1)))
}

fn solve(a1: Int, a2: Int) -> Int
  requires (a1 >= 1)
  requires (a2 >= 1)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result == CountValidMinutes(a1, a2))
  ensures ((not ((a1 == 1) and (a2 == 1))) or (result == 0))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
